analysis: Independent arithmetic from per-replica data; checks summary values and same-frame joint hydrogen-bond geometry directly against all saved-frame records. No scripts, source data, manuscript, model, or trajectories modified.
supports: The engineered complex has greater Q72 side-chain contact occupancy with the beta Phe53/Gly54 backbone patch in each of its three independent trajectories.
Unchanged beta Gly54 RMSF is lower in every engineered trajectory than in every WT trajectory.
Q72 Hchi is lower in the engineered three-replica mean, while replica ranges overlap.
Q72 Hchi and Gly54 RMSF provide complementary site-specific readings of the same remodeled contact patch.

This local contact and dynamic interpretation is consistent with the primary article structural increase in MHC contacts and experimentally slower dissociation, without quantifying the kinetic contribution of Q72.

must_modify.replacement: 工程体中相应接触的占据率更高；若要使用持续时间更长，需要独立分析连续驻留时间。占据率本身不等同于寿命。

must_modify.phrase: Q72 Hchi 降低使 Gly54 RMSF 降低 / 直接证明耦合方向
must_modify.replacement: 亲和成熟重排该接触片区，Q72 侧链取向集中与 Gly54 主链波动降低共同出现。20 ns 窗口相关正负混合，不能宣称单向因果。

must_modify.phrase: Q72 在工程体每条轨迹中 Hchi 都低于 WT
must_modify.replacement: Q72 的三重复平均 Hchi 较低。两状态重复范围存在重叠，不能写成所有重复分离。

must_modify.phrase: Q72 是亲和力提高或解离减慢的决定原因
must_modify.replacement: 该片区的动态变化与原研究新增 MHC 接触、解离减慢的结果相呼应；其单独贡献未被测定。

must_modify.phrase: 桥连在全部或几乎全部工程帧中同时形成两条氢键
must_modify.replacement: 满足双端氢键几何的同帧占据为三重复平均 37.15%，各重复 33.20%–39.48%；几何接触约 97% 不能替代双端氢键同帧比例。

recommended_zh: 亲和成熟后，HLA Q72 与 TCR beta Phe53/Gly54 骨架的局部接触网络得到加强。已有三重复轨迹中，Q72 与未替换 Gly54 的几何接触占据由 24.4% 提高至 97.4%，满足 Q72 NE2 到 Gly54 主链 O 氢键几何的占据由 0.9% 提高至 42.8%；与 Phe53 主链 N 的对应占据也提高至 82.0%。模型同时将 Q72 的侧链取向集中和 Gly54 的骨架波动减小定位到这一片区，分别预测 Hchi 由 1.792 降至 1.375 nats、RMSF 由 1.118 降至 0.747 A。这为原研究报道的新增 TCR–MHC 接触与解离减慢提供了具体的局部动态解释。
